example.title: Charles Major School, 102 East Franklin Street

brief: Two-storey 1922 brick elementary school with a raised basement: a long symmetrical front of banded window groups, a projecting central entrance pavilion with a round-arched doorway and a shaped parapet with stone trim, and plain side wings. Chain-link fenced playground at the back.
